subject: 1,000 new tasks are live, free until 12pm tomorrow
heading: 1,000 new tasks are live
lines: We've just added 1,000 new tasks to YOLOTASK across Instagram, YouTube, X, TikTok, Facebook and Threads. They're in your task feed right now.
All tasks are free to access until 12:00 pm (WAT) tomorrow, Tuesday, November 10, 2026.

From 12:00 pm, you'll need to activate your account with a one-time fee of ₦500 to keep seeing and doing tasks. You can activate any time from your dashboard by bank transfer. It's a one-off payment, not a subscription.
Start earning now while everything is free.
